info.name: Teacher App (Flutter) — localhost
info.description:
Teacher APK API. Every URL is a full localhost URL (API gateway on port 5000). There is no baseUrl variable.

HOW TO USE
1. Start the backend (api-gateway :5000, auth-service :5001, platform-service :5002).
2. Run "01 Auth → Login". The token is saved to the collection variable {{token}} automatically.
3. Run the folders top to bottom. List requests save the first id they find (classId, sectionId, studentId, homeworkId …) so the detail requests after them work without copy-paste.

Envelope: success → {success:true, data, …}; error → {success:false, message, code} + HTTP status. 402 = school subscription expired (show a blocking screen).
